disconnect.title: Disconnect from GitLab?
disconnect.message: Your GitLab credentials, cache, unsent comments saved on this device, and records of posts with unconfirmed results will be deleted. To replace only the token, use "Update token".
token.updateDescription: Reconnect with a new token for the same account (@{username}). Unsent comments and the records used to confirm sent comments are kept. A token for another account can't be used.
token.label: Personal access token
token.scopeHint: Browsing needs the read_api scope; comments and approvals need the api scope.
token.urlFirst: First enter a GitLab URL that starts with https://.
connect.title: Connect to GitLab
connect.description: Choose a server and start reviewing.
connect.unsupported: You can't connect in the browser preview. Start the desktop app.
connect.urlHint: HTTPS URL of GitLab.com or your company's GitLab (a host name is enough)
connect.urlInvalid: The GitLab URL must start with https://.
connect.storage: Credentials are stored in Windows Credential Manager.
reauth.title: Reauthentication required
reauth.descriptionUser: The token for @{username} no longer works. Enter a new token for the same account to reconnect while keeping unsent comments and the records used to confirm sent comments.
reauth.descriptionSaved: The saved token no longer works. Enter a new token for the same account to reconnect while keeping unsent comments and the records used to confirm sent comments.
glab.hint: Choose from the servers saved in glab and start connecting.
glab.dialogDescription: Connect with the saved credentials of the selected server.

glab.noHttps: Couldn't read any HTTPS servers. Check your glab settings, or use the PAT form below.
glab.readFailed: Couldn't read the servers saved in glab. Check the settings, or use the PAT form below.
glab.selectRequired: Select a server saved in glab.
glab.targetsLabel: GitLab servers logged in with glab
